node.title: Re^5: You won't believe what this regular expression does!
node.author: salva
node.doctext:
No, the intent is to ensure that the string ends in just one o, no less, no more than one.

In real life, those lines were paths, and I wanted all of then ending in a single slash. For instance: /foo --> /foo/ /foo/ --> /foo/ /foo////// --> /foo/
